title: Accounts and Payroll Assistant
description:
Portfolio Payroll are working with a leading a reputable accountancy practice in Altrincham who is looking to appoint an Accounts Assistant with strong all-round finance experience. This role suits someone with 2-3 years' experience who can confidently support the full end-to-end accounts process, including AP/AR, VAT, reconciliations, and some payroll administration.

They're open to AAT / ACCA qualified or qualified by experience, and ideally someone familiar with Sage, Xero or IRIS.

Responsibilities
- End-to-end payroll and accounts - journals, reconciliations, month-end support
- Accounts Payable - processing invoices, supplier payments
- Accounts Receivable - credit control, customer accounts
- VAT returns - preparation and submission
- Payroll admin - assisting with monthly payroll tasks
- Bank reconciliations - maintaining accurate financial records
- General finance admin - filing, data entry, client communication
- Software - Sage / Xero / IRIS preferred

Requirements
- 2-3 years' finance experience (practice or industry)
- AAT / ACCA qualified or QBE
- Strong understanding of double-entry, reconciliations, and VAT
- Strong understanding of end to end Payroll
- Confident communicator with excellent attention to detail
- Ability to manage a varied workload independently

What's on offer
- Salary up to £35,000 (flexible for the right candidate)
- Study support for AAT/ACCA
- Clear progression within a growing practice
- Exposure to a wide range of clients
- Supportive, friendly finance team

title: Air Freight Imports Coordinator
description:
Air Freight Imports Coordinator

Location: Greater Manchester
Salary: Competitive + Benefits

Reed is delighted to be partnering with a well-established international logistics organisation seeking an experienced Air Freight Imports Coordinator to join its growing operations team. This is an excellent opportunity for an air freight professional who enjoys managing shipments from arrival through to final delivery while ensuring high levels of customer service and operational accuracy.

The Opportunity

Working within a fast-paced freight forwarding environment, you will oversee import airfreight shipments, liaising with overseas partners, airlines, customs authorities, transport providers and customers to ensure cargo moves efficiently and compliantly.

The successful candidate will be highly organised, customer focused and confident managing multiple shipments simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate international air import shipments from pre-alert through to final delivery
- Monitor shipment progress and provide timely updates to customers and stakeholders
- Arrange customs clearance activities and ensure all import documentation is accurate and compliant
- Liaise with overseas agents, airlines, haulage providers and warehouse partners to facilitate smooth cargo movement
- Verify supplier costs and prepare customer invoicing in line with agreed commercial arrangements
- Resolve operational issues, delays or service disruptions with a proactive approach
- Maintain accurate records within the freight management system
- Ensure all shipments are processed in accordance with regulatory requirements and internal procedures
- Support customer retention through consistent service delivery and effective communication
- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service performance

About You
- Previous experience within air freight forwarding, with a particular focus on imports
- Good understanding of customs procedures and import documentation requirements
- Strong knowledge of the international freight and logistics sector
- Ability to prioritise workload in a time-sensitive environment
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- Strong attention to detail and administrative accuracy
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications
- Experience using freight forwarding software would be advantageous
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

What's on Offer
- Join a respected and expanding logistics business
- Supportive and collaborative working culture
- Career development and progression opportunities
- Competitive salary and benefits package

To find out more about this confidential opportunity, please contact Adam Norris at Reed or apply now.

title: Bankruptcy Administrator
description:
Bankruptcy Administrator - Manchester

Acting Agency: Imperium Financial Recruitment

Imperium Financial Recruitment is proud to be working with a highly regarded and growing insolvency practice in Manchester, seeking a Bankruptcy Administrator to join their expanding team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with experience in personal insolvency to take the next step in their career. You will be responsible for managing a caseload of bankruptcy files from start to finish, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements while delivering excellent service to clients.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing your own portfolio of bankruptcy cases.
- Liaising with creditors, debtors, and other stakeholders.
- Preparing reports and statutory documentation.
- Ensuring cases are progressed efficiently and in line with deadlines.
- Supporting the wider insolvency team as required.

Ideal Candidate:
- Previous experience working within personal insolvency or bankruptcy administration.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a busy team.
- Good attention to detail and a proactive approach.

Location: Manchester

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

If you are looking to progress your insolvency career in a forward-thinking firm, this is the perfect opportunity.

title: Debt Recovery Paralegal
description:
Amazing opportunity to join a full-service law firm. I'm currently assisting a close client, a well-established, forward-thinking law firm, on an opportunity for a Paralegal to join its Commercial Debt Litigation team in Manchester.

This is a great role for someone with prior debt recovery experience who is looking to take the next step in a supportive, fast-paced environment with clear progression opportunities.

The role:

You'll manage a varied caseload of debt recovery matters, working across the full lifecycle of claims. This includes:
- Drafting letters of claim and reviewing agreements
- Profiling debtors and assessing recovery prospects
- Negotiating settlements and liaising with clients
- Issuing proceedings, entering judgment and progressing enforcement action
- Managing files, billing and reporting

What the firm is looking for:
- Essential: previous debt recovery experience
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Confident communication and negotiation skills
- Ability to manage your own caseload

What's on offer?
- Hybrid working (minimum 2 days in office)
- 25 days' holiday (rising with service) + buy/sell option
- Private medical, life insurance & income protection
- Enhanced family leave and pension
- Additional perks including wellbeing support and retail discounts

If you have debt recovery experience and want to build your career in a progressive firm, get in touch asap.

title: Plot Sales Paralegal
company: The Eventus Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Eventus Legal are seeking a Plot Sales Paralegal to join a well-established, award-winning law firm based in Hale, Cheshire. This is a full-time, permanent job position offering a salary of up to £30,000 depending on experience, alongside an employee bonus scheme of up to 10% of salary, a healthcare package with 24/7 GP access and contributions towards dental treatment, glasses and physiotherapy, company pension, death in service cover, Pure Gym membership and a paid day off for your birthday. This opportunity has arisen through internal progression, allowing for a new an available position within the plot sales team.Role Responsibilities

Joining the Residential Property team, the Plot Sales Paralegal will support the efficient progression of plot sales and wider residential property matters. Key responsibilities will include:
- Drafting, reviewing and organising legal documents relating to residential property transactions
- Managing case files and ensuring documentation is accurate, complete and kept up to date
- Liaising with clients, solicitors and external parties to progress matters and obtain required information
- Preparing correspondence, reports and schedules using Microsoft Office
- Supporting the team with case preparation, document management and day-to-day workflow
- Maintaining confidentiality and high standards of client care throughout each matter

Person Specification

This opportunity will suit a detail-focused paralegal with residential property experience and a particular interest in plot sales work. Applications are welcomed from candidates who can demonstrate the following:
- Previous experience working as a Paralegal or Legal Assistant with experience of plot sales work
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent organisation and time management, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook, with the ability to learn legal case management systems
- A proactive, self-motivated approach and the ability to work both independently and as part of a busy team
- A strong commitment to accurate work and high standards of client care

Benefits and Rewards

The firm offers a broad employee benefits package alongside the opportunity to develop within an established property practice. The successful Plot Sales Paralegal will also benefit from:
- Salary of up to £30,000 depending on experience
- Employee bonus scheme providing up to an additional 10% of salary annually, subject to terms and conditions
- Healthcare package providing 24/7 GP access
- £100 towards dental treatment per annum
- £100 towards glasses per annum
- £250 towards physiotherapy per annum
- Free Annual eye tests
- Free Annual hearing tests
- Death in service insurance paying four times salary
- Company pension
- Pet insurance for cats and dogs, subject to conditions
- Counselling service
- Monthly office massages of 15 minutes per person
- Pure Gym membership
- Annual flu jab
- A paid day off for your birthday
- Netflix/Spotify/Amazon Prime/Apple News+ subscriptions

About the Law Firm

This award-winning, Legal 500-recognised law firm has a strong reputation across property and wider commercial legal services. The firm is known for high-quality work, a client-focused approach and a commitment to developing its people. Internal progression is actively supported, and this vacancy has arisen because an existing member of the plot sales team has progressed into a training contract. The Plot Sales Paralegal will join a growing property practice with exposure to residential property, property development and related plot sales work in Hale, Cheshire.

Next Steps

Apply now to be considered for this career-enhancing job opportunity. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion about this Plot Sales Paralegal job, please send your CV to Sonia Idris at the Eventus Recruitment Group or call for a confidential discussion.
